create_callback_watch_model: create a PyTorch Lightning callback to watch model gradients and parameters in Weights & Biases
create_callback_upload_code: create a PyTorch Lightning callback to upload code files as a Weights & Biases artifact
create_callback_upload_checkpoints: create a PyTorch Lightning callback to upload model checkpoints as a Weights & Biases artifact
create_callback_log_confusion_matrix: create a PyTorch Lightning callback to log a confusion matrix heatmap to Weights & Biases every validation epoch
create_callback_log_f1_prec_rec: create a PyTorch Lightning callback to log F1, precision, and recall heatmaps to Weights & Biases every validation epoch
